what_changes: a line that is ONLY a '[Non-Text]'-shaped placeholder is dropped entirely; an inline placeholder elsewhere on a line is removed in place
what_does_not_change: every money token, the date, and all surrounding text; a line carrying a placeholder PLUS other content is never dropped (fullmatch guard), only the bracket substring is removed from it
semantics_note: the placeholder pattern matches only the literal bracket text; a numeric token on the same line defeats the line-drop path's fullmatch guard, so no financial content is ever removed
